needs_human.note: /search/images answers 503 when every id in one hydration batch is legitimately absent from the core's active set, not only when hydration fails.

Still present from r2 (R2-1), not addressed by this test-only round. After a bulk tag, rename or move whose selection holds only continuation rows, refresh() is skipped, and the drawn rows keep the file data from the /search/images answer (old filename, tags, folder_path). The text filter then matches the old filename.; Still present from r1/r2: copy and cut call onClear without onComplete, so clearedSelectionRef in FolderBrowser keeps stale ids until the next onClear overwrites them. Nothing reads those ids before that overwrite, so no wrong result follows.
